name: pe2-animui
prompt:
Kreative Studio web UI (STU-PE2, the Animation part of the Pose tab). Plain browser JavaScript, no modules, no libraries, no build step. Write public/js/pose-anim.js: the timeline of the Animation section in the Pose tab. One IIFE with 'use strict'. It runs after pose-panel.js, which sets window.KKPoseEditor = {stage, ...} on DOMContentLoaded; set up on DOMContentLoaded too (or at once when the document is already loaded), after pose-panel. Pose modules are on window.KKPose: KKPose.anim (EASES, newClip, setKey(clip, t, pose, ease), removeKey(clip, t), sample(clip, t)) and KKPose.clips (CLIPS.walk). The stage: stage.getPose(), stage.setPose(p) (undo step + refit), stage.preview(p, fast) (no undo, no refit).

copy = (x) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)). fmt(t) = t.toFixed(2) + ' s'.
State: clip = KKPose.anim.newClip(); time = 0; sel = -1 (index of the selected key); playing = false; raf = 0; last = 0.
Elements by id: anim-walk, anim-new, anim-timeline, anim-play, anim-time, anim-time-val, anim-add, anim-remove, anim-ease, anim-fps, anim-length, anim-loop, error-msg-anim.

- keyAt(t): index of the key with |key.t - t| < 1e-6, else -1.
- render(): rebuild #anim-timeline: for each key i a <button type="button" class="anim-key"> with dataset.t = String(key.t), style.left = (key.t / clip.length * 100) + '%', aria-label 'Key at ' + fmt(key.t), aria-pressed String(i === sel), text String(i + 1), click -> selectKey(i); then a <div class="anim-playhead" aria-hidden="true"> with style.left = (time / clip.length * 100) + '%'. Time slider: max = clip.length, step = 1 / clip.fps, value = time; #anim-time-val text fmt(time). #anim-add text sel >= 0 ? 'Update key' : 'Add key'. #anim-remove disabled = sel < 0. When sel >= 0, #anim-ease value = that key's ease. #anim-fps value String(clip.fps), #anim-length value String(clip.length), #anim-loop checked clip.loop. #anim-play text playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play' and aria-pressed String(playing).
- show(fast): when clip.keys.length > 0: stage.preview(sel >= 0 ? copy(clip.keys[sel].pose) : KKPose.anim.sample(clip, time), fast). Then render().
- selectKey(i): stop(); sel = i; time = clip.keys[i].t; stage.setPose(copy(clip.keys[i].pose)); render().
- Time slider 'input': stop(); time = Math.round(+value * clip.fps) / clip.fps (whole frames, so a key lands on 0.125 and not 0.12499999); sel = keyAt(time); show(false).
- #anim-add click: clip = KKPose.anim.setKey(clip, time, stage.getPose(), #anim-ease value), keeping the ik of a key that was already at that time (copy it onto the new key); sel = keyAt(time); render(). Errors go to #error-msg-anim (clear it at the start of every action).
- #anim-remove click: when sel >= 0: clip = KKPose.anim.removeKey(clip, clip.keys[sel].t); sel = -1; show(false).
- #anim-ease change: when sel >= 0: replace that key's ease in a copy of clip (clip = copy(clip); clip.keys[sel].ease = value); render().
- #anim-play click: playing ? stop() : start(). start(): if clip has no keys, show the error 'Add a key first.' and return; playing = true; sel = -1; if (!clip.loop && time >= clip.length) time = 0; last = performance.now(); raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); render(). tick(now): time += (now - last) / 1000; last = now; when time >= clip.length: loop ? time %= clip.length : (time = clip.length, then show(false) and stop() and return); show(true); raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick). stop(): when playing: playing = false; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); sel = keyAt(time); show(false); else nothing.
- #anim-fps change: clip = {...copy(clip), fps: +value}; render().
- #anim-length change: v = +value; if not (v > 0 && v <= 60): error 'Length is a number of seconds above 0, up to 60.' and render(); else clip = copy(clip), clip.length = v, keep only keys with t < v (loop) or t <= v (no loop); time = Math.min(time, v); sel = keyAt(time); render().
- #anim-loop change: clip = copy(clip); clip.loop = checked; when loop, keep only keys with t < clip.length; sel = keyAt(time); render().
- #anim-walk click: stop(); clip = copy(KKPose.clips.CLIPS.walk); selectKey(0).
- #anim-new click: stop(); clip = KKPose.anim.newClip({fps: clip.fps, length: clip.length, loop: clip.loop}); sel = -1; time = 0; render().
- window.KKAnimEditor = {clip: () => copy(clip), time: () => time, playing: () => playing, setClip(c) {stop(); clip = copy(c); time = 0; sel = -1; if (clip.keys.length) selectKey(0); else render();}, error(msg) {#error-msg-anim text = msg}}.
- Call render() once at the end of setup.
